title: Paris-based Comand AI, which is developing AI-based command-and-control software for military operations, raised a €32M Series A led by Blossom Capital (Ingrid Lunden/Resilience Media)
summary: Ingrid Lunden / Resilience Media: Paris-based Comand AI, which is developing AI-based command-and-control software for military operations, raised a €32M Series A led by Blossom Capital — French startup emerges at a time when tech sovereignty has become a major talking point in defence
